site.name: Jazz 9×9
site.homeTitle: Degree, chord and scale drills you do in your head
site.homeDescription: Three mental drills for jazz: intervals by degree, chord tones and scale notes. No instrument needed. Your reaction time is how long each correct answer takes you.
site.ogAlt: Jazz 9×9 — mental drills for jazz, no instrument needed

degree-id.title: Degree tables
degree-id.description: Two notes appear. Pick which degree the second note is from the first, out of 12.
degree-id.rules: Two notes appear. Pick which degree the second note is, counted from the first, out of 12. A round is 20 questions, and the next one comes up as soon as you answer.
degree-id.seoDescription: Degree tables: see two notes and name the degree instantly. A mental drill for jazz, no instrument needed.

chord-construction.title: Chord tables
chord-construction.description: Read the chord name and pick its notes. Triad and 7th modes.
chord-construction.rules: Read the chord name and pick its notes. It grades itself once you've picked enough. Triad and 7th modes, 10 questions per round.
chord-construction.seoDescription: Chord tables: read a chord name and pick its notes instantly. A mental drill for jazz, no instrument needed.

scale-construction.title: Scale tables
scale-construction.description: Read the root and scale name and pick the notes fast.
scale-construction.rules: Read the root and scale name and pick the notes. It grades itself once you've picked enough. A round is 10 questions, and you can narrow the question pool in the settings below.
scale-construction.seoDescription: Scale tables: read a root and a scale name and pick the notes instantly. A mental drill for jazz, no instrument needed.

landing.heroBody: 2 × 7 = 14 comes out without thinking. Dm7 = D F A C should too. Degrees, chords, scales. Play on the train or over lunch, no instrument needed, and track how many seconds each correct answer takes you.
landing.sampleAria: Notes of Bb7: Bb D F Ab
landing.indexUnit: Unit — Reaction (s) · time per correct answer
landing.stat1Body: Every chord and scale answer is somewhere in the 12 note names. No instrument, just the keys on screen.
landing.stat2Body: Major, three minors, pentatonic, blues, Dorian, Mixolydian, Lydian.
landing.stat3Body: Only rounds above this accuracy count toward your level. Guessing won't move you up.
landing.scoringTitle: Fast and accurate moves you up.
landing.scoringBody: When a round ends, your time is divided by your correct answers to get your reaction time, in seconds. Lower is faster. Your level comes from the average of your recent rounds, and each level you reach is saved with its date.
landing.scoringLogAria: Sample scoring log for a round
landing.notice: Rounds under {gate}% accuracy don't count toward your level.

faq.a: No. In all three games you pick note names or degrees on screen, so it's all done in your head.
Degrees between notes, chord tones and scale notes are the sums you repeat every bar when you improvise. The goal is to make them automatic, like times tables.

faq.q: How is reaction time worked out?
faq.a: It's the time each correct answer takes you: your round time divided by your correct answers, in seconds, so lower is faster. The average of your recent rounds sets your level: proficient, fluent or master.
Your level and practice history are saved in this browser. If you join with a nickname and password, your rounds also go on the leaderboard.

faq.q: How do I get on the leaderboard?
faq.a: Finish a round, then set a nickname and a password on the result screen. No email needed. Your single fastest round with 90% accuracy or better is what ranks. Chord tables only counts 7th mode, and Scale tables only counts rounds with the full question pool.

faq.q: Where did the lessons and the Tree go?
faq.a: They're taken down for now. The site is focused on the three tables.

landing.painB: The notes just aren't coming to mind.
landing.painBody: If a chord's notes don't come to you the moment you see it, Jazz 9×9 comes before more time on your instrument.
landing.commuteTitle: One round fits in a single subway stop.
landing.commuteBody: At the proficient level, 20 questions take about 2 minutes. Get the part you can do without an instrument done on the way, and spend your time on the instrument just playing.
landing.commuteExample: G7 = G B D F — until it comes out without thinking.
